title: Whispering Boots and the pimps of old Rampart Street
summary: Tex describes the gangster Whispering Boots and other notorious pimps of the pre-integration nightlife.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: I really don't know his real name. As a young kid coming up and doing business up and down Ramports, you always heard of Whispering Boots.

Well, Whispering Boots belonged to that era that we discussed sometime with Fast Life Eddie, Big Coochie, Treacherous Slim, Bulldog Jackson, Midnight Willie, Deep Dick Johnny. All these guys were big-time pimps, and they had women of the evening where you could go to the little, in the little alleys where they had these little motels or little small rooms. And this was before they could go to the downtown hotels. All this is a part of the jazz era of music, the way black people lived at that particular time. And like I said, it belongs to history. And a lot of that was related on an old WMRY radio station that I worked on many a day.
